boundary_method: User reported a music interruption; boundaries were located from the two largest persistent changes in the centered 10-recording median of the 0.8-second pre-message RMS.

music_development.purpose: Development and interference-aware training; includes the previously inspected 20-packet pilot.

quiet_regression.purpose: Check that interference work does not regress the same physical channel when music is absent.

music_validation.purpose: Temporally separate music-on validation block; do not train on these recordings.

limitations: All partitions share one room, microphone, playback speaker, and collection day.
The validation block has already received one aggregate baseline evaluation; avoid per-example tuning against it.
A future separate session with different music is required for a pristine interference-generalization claim.
